Main.dc.html.title: Foundations — tokens, type, components, iced mapping

n_main.text:
How to use this canvas

• Built on the home-space design system (the web client's tokens), so web and desktop read as one product.
• Every artboard has a Dark theme tweak.
• Shared styles: project/hs.css. Token names match the design system; the Foundations board shows how they map onto an iced custom Theme / extended palette.
• Type: Noto Sans here to match iced on KDE; the app keeps the system UI font.

n_signin.text:
Sign in — changes

• Centred login card on color-bg with the soft accent glow (as in the web client).
• Server field shows its state inline (checking / connected / error).
• SSO is the primary button; password below an “or” divider.
• Resuming failed gets an icon, a reason and Retry as the primary action.

n_files.text:
Files — changes

• Sidebar for the places: Files, Sync queue, Recycle bin, Devices (today they are toolbar buttons on the right). Sync status and the account move to the sidebar footer; Sign out lives in the account menu.
• Header: breadcrumbs as the title, search on the right.
• Toolbar: Upload is the one primary button; New folder, Refresh, Open in web stay ghost buttons.
• The local sync path is no longer repeated under every row. A chip above the list says where this folder syncs; a row only gets a second line when it differs (own location, or “Not synced”).
• Listing sits in one bordered box (radius-md) with the sticky overline header; Size gets its own column for files.
• Selection replaces the toolbar with a count + actions bar; the context menu keeps the same actions with shortcuts.
• Details opens as a 320px side panel with previous versions.
• Transfers float bottom-right; dropping files shows the dashed accent overlay.

n_dialogs.text:
Dialogs — changes

• One modal style: radius-lg panel, shadow-lg, backdrop with 2px blur.
• Buttons: secondary (outlined surface) + primary (accent) on the right; danger actions use color-danger.
• Move shows breadcrumbs and an Up row; Move here is disabled while the current folder is the source.
• Sync a folder: confirms the local path before anything is written.

n_pages.text:
Pages — changes

• Same frame as Files: sidebar stays, the page title replaces breadcrumbs.
• Sync queue: summary line, sections (Syncing now / Could not sync / Waiting) with per-item progress and Retry.
• Recycle bin: original path column, Restore as primary, Empty recycle bin as danger.
• Devices: one row per device with state; Rename and Sign out in the row menu.
• Sync settings move from a modal to a full page, opened from the sync status in the sidebar.

Proposals beyond today’s features (drop if unwanted): Ctrl+K to focus search, password show/hide, Delete permanently for a selection in the recycle bin, the per-row sync state line.
